scope: Generated synchronous calls retain Oop inputs, exact aliases and fresh results across reentry and collection
retained_checks: Callback releases the sole external input token, collects and observes both heap input identities in the allocated-object list
Direct and nested generated calls return the exact input alias
Fresh Word result remains alive across the collecting callback and after returning to a rooted caller
Native failure preserves exact object identity
Captured Method keeps its old implementation after replacement; future sends enter the replacement
Required non-null Oop rejection occurs before the body; supported immediate Oops are accepted
representation_change: The former invalid Operand::word input has no distinct carrier in the Oop-only interface. Required-object admission is checked with null rejection and positive supported-immediate acceptance, matching the existing native_incoming contract. No raw pointers to potentially reclaimed objects are queried.
remaining: Remaining native/compiler harnesses and optimization scope decisions
